max_relative_change: `MomentumRequirement` reads the momentum headroom, which takes part in the fit (exponent 0.107 primary, 0.181 baseline).

`PowerRequirement` holds at every in-range configuration (the model's claim `PowerRequirementHoldsInRange`, proved by the solver); reads the available power, one axis with the energy balance (Spearman +0.9997 primary, +0.9997 baseline), so the reading sums their exponents (0.197 primary, 0.192 baseline).

`BatteryPeakPowerRequirement` holds at every in-range configuration (the model's claim `BatteryPeakPowerRequirementHoldsInRange`, proved by the solver); reads the battery peak power ratio, which the fit gives exponent zero; it tracks the depth of discharge (Spearman +0.971 primary, +0.975 baseline).
